title: PortalHostView
description: Source of truth: DHT (Notarized, Category A). PortalHost declares URLs authorized to render this human's auth portal. Anchored on the Human entry's ActionHash so portal hosts survive KeyRotation. M5 ships only reach=trusted.

humanId.description: ActionHash (base64url) of the Human entry this PortalHost anchors on

lastReachableAt.description: Operational enrichment from libp2p; not part of notarized entry

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash (base64url) of the PortalHost entry; canonical PK
